text:
Dark mode is live

As of May 12, dark mode is available to everyone. It was one of our most requested features, with nearly 40% of beta testers asking for it.

We did more than invert the colors. Body text has a 7:1 contrast ratio, which meets the WCAG AAA standard, so your notes stay easy to read at midnight or at a table by a sunny window.

What you get:

- **Less glare** when you're writing late at night
- **Sharp text** thanks to the high contrast
- **One-tap switching** between light and dark

To turn it on, open Settings and choose the theme you want.

Thanks to everyone who asked for this and tested it with us. We'll keep working on the features you request.

---

*Note: I changed "exceeds" to "meets." WCAG AAA requires a contrast ratio of at least 7:1 for body text, so a 7:1 ratio meets the standard but doesn't exceed it. If the real ratio is higher than 7:1, put that number back with "exceeds."*
